Detailed Description

Runtime interface to a bot instance in a Scene.

A Bot wraps a single articulated Actor with the controllers, sensors, and actuators created for it. Bots are created via CreateBot and destroyed via DestroyBot. The RoboticsContext owns the bot memory allocated and deallocated by these functions, respectively. The raw Bot* returned by CreateBot remains valid until DestroyBot is called or the RoboticsContext is destroyed.

Note
Not thread-safe – like the underlying Scene, a Bot must only be accessed from the thread that owns its scene (usually in an async callback if using async scenes.)

superdex::Error & error )
nodiscardpure virtual

Create an actuator of the given type on one of this bot's links.

The actuator counterpart to CreateSensor, for actuators only known at runtime rather than declared as a BotActuatorPrefab. It joins GetActuatorHandles and is destroyed with the bot.

Parameters
[in]typeNameRegistered actuator type.
[in]linkNameName of the link (from BotPrefab::links) to attach the actuator to.
[in]nameInstance name, used by FindActuatorsByName. Names need not be unique.
[in]paramArgsOptional params file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Pointer to the new actuator, or nullptr on error.

Create a sensor of the given type on one of this bot's links.

The bot-level counterpart to declaring a BotSensorPrefab in the BotPrefab, for sensors that are only known at runtime. The sensor joins GetSensorHandles and is destroyed with the bot, exactly like an auto-instantiated one.

Parameters
[in]typeNameRegistered sensor type (e.g. "SENSOR_CAMERA").

[in]nameInstance name, used by FindSensorsByName. Names need not be unique.
[in]paramArgsOptional params file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.

◆ GetController()

virtual ControllerBase * superdex::robotics::Bot::GetController ( ControllerHandle controllerHandle,
superdex::Error & error ) const
nodiscardpure virtual

Resolve a controller handle to its underlying ControllerBase.

Unlike RoboticsContext::GetController, which resolves any handle in the context, this checks the controller belongs to this bot first — so a handle from another bot, or from a standalone actor, is reported as an error rather than silently resolved.

Parameters
[in]controllerHandleHandle returned by GetControllerHandles.
[in,out]errorError status. Set if the handle is invalid or does not belong to this bot.
Returns
Pointer to the controller, or nullptr on error.

◆ GetControllerHandles()

virtual DynamicArray< ControllerHandle > superdex::robotics::Bot::GetControllerHandles ( ) const
nodiscardpure virtual

Get the handles of every controller this bot owns.

Covers controllers created through CreateController and those created on one of this bot's actors with RoboticsContext::CreateController — the owning bot is inferred from the actor (see RoboticsContext::GetBotContainingActor), so how a controller was created makes no difference to whether it appears here. Mirrors GetSensorHandles: the same set the bot-scoped finders draw from, and the same set DestroyBot tears down. Resolve each handle with RoboticsContext::GetController.

Returns
A snapshot of the bot's controller handles, in creation order.

◆ GetSensorHandles()

virtual DynamicArray< SensorHandle > superdex::robotics::Bot::GetSensorHandles ( ) const
nodiscardpure virtual

Get the handles of every sensor this bot owns.

Covers sensors declared per link in the BotPrefab via BotSensorPrefab and instantiated by CreateBot, those added afterwards via CreateSensor, and those created straight off one of this bot's actors with RoboticsContext::CreateSensor — the owning bot is inferred from the actor (see RoboticsContext::GetBotContainingActor), so how a sensor was created makes no difference to whether it appears here. This is the same set the bot-scoped finders draw from, and the same set DestroyBot tears down. Use RoboticsContext::GetSensor on each handle to obtain the underlying SensorBase pointer.

Returns
A snapshot of the bot's sensor handles in creation order: the BotPrefab::links entries first (by link, then by per-link sensor index), followed by any later additions.
